usedFor: Vyte holds events, and Razorpay creates a payment link when “Event Is Confirmed” runs “Create Payment Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “Event Is Confirmed” in Vyte, then “Create Payment Link” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: A confirmed event gets a shareable link with amount and expiry, so payment can be collected.

watchOut: “Event Cancelled” and “Event Is Updated” fire separately, so a changed event does not update an existing payment link.
